stories.headline: Nasdaq 100 Futures Rise as Investors Brace for Nvidia Earnings
stories.summary: Tech stocks climbed and the recent AI-trade selloff eased ahead of Nvidia's earnings report, a release many see as a key stress test for the AI trade. Nvidia shares are down roughly 35% from October highs amid mounting tech sector turmoil.

stories.headline: European Stocks Fall as New US Chip Curbs Ignite Fresh AI Selloff
stories.summary: European equities declined after fresh US restrictions on Chinese access to advanced AI semiconductors rattled tech investors. The move adds to a string of AI-trade jitters that have pressured emerging-market and Asian tech shares for four straight sessions.

stories.headline: Fed's Musalem Says Economy Likely to Need 'Several' Rate Hikes by Spring
stories.summary: St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem signaled support for multiple interest-rate increases in the coming months to achieve price stability. The hawkish comments add to a mixed Fed chorus, with Cleveland's Hammack separately saying she prefers small, incremental hikes but sees risk of bigger moves.

stories.headline: US Retail Sales Rise 0.2% in October Amid Mixed Demand
stories.summary: US retail sales growth moderated in October as a pullback in big-ticket items like autos masked resilient demand for other goods, a signal for consumer spending heading into the holiday season.

stories.headline: Nvidia Forms Export Control Board Committee After Chip Curbs
stories.summary: Nvidia established a new board-level oversight committee focused on national security and export controls following the latest round of US restrictions on China's AI chip access, ahead of its closely watched earnings release.

stories.headline: Amazon, Google to Hold About 28% of Anthropic Stock After IPO
stories.summary: Amazon and Alphabet, two of Anthropic's largest customers and investors, will collectively hold roughly 28% of the AI company's stock following its planned Nasdaq IPO. Hedge fund Coatue Management separately holds a stake reported at $10 billion, while retail investors are seeking exposure via ETFs, closed-end funds, swaps and perps ahead of the listing.

stories.headline: Disney Profit Beats as Marvel Films Power Streaming
stories.summary: Disney posted earnings that exceeded expectations, with Marvel film releases helping drive strong performance in its streaming division.

stories.headline: Home Depot Names McPhail CEO With Decker Returning as Chairman
stories.summary: Home Depot named Richard McPhail as chief executive officer, while Ted Decker returns from medical leave to serve as chairman, marking a leadership transition at the home-improvement retailer.
